note: Before the evidence-run take, update the rai_gate date and verdict in governance/register.yaml to the recorded episode 6 gate (TODO in that file; not edited here). If the deny-model command unexpectedly succeeds, keep the take: the evidence pack then shows MOD-01 FAIL; teardown removes the deployment with the group.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-07 -l swedencentral -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-07 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-07 failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 900   # Azure Policy assignments need at least 15 minutes before the deny scenes

screens.name: deny-keys
commands: az cognitiveservices account create -g rg-mglab-ai-07 -n contoso-keys-test -l swedencentral --kind OpenAI --sku S0 --custom-domain contoso-keys-test --yes
mask: the CLI error prints the full resource ID with the subscription GUID: blur it in this capture

screens.name: deny-model
commands: az cognitiveservices account deployment create -g rg-mglab-ai-07 -n $env:AOAI_NAME --deployment-name nano --model-name gpt-4.1-nano --model-version 2025-04-14 --model-format OpenAI --sku-name GlobalStandard --sku-capacity 1
mask: the CLI error prints the full resource ID with the subscription GUID: blur it in this capture

screens.name: evidence-run
mask: reports/snapshot.json must not be opened on camera

screens.name: compliance-manager
steps: Check the licence counter first; show 'Premium AI templates' with 'EU Artificial Intelligence Act'
Create the assessment 'HR assistant: EU AI Act' (new group 'AI systems')
Open one improvement action > Evidence tab > Add evidence > Document
Upload reports/evidence-hr-bot.txt (written by the evidence-run); it appears in the evidence list

teardown: # owner: in Purview delete the assessment 'HR assistant: EU AI Act' (Compliance Manager > Assessments > ... > Delete); an activated premium regulation keeps counting toward the free three
az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-07 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-07 -n $env:SHADOW_NAME -l swedencentral
